newsitem.title: UK: Reuters shares fall after results.
newsitem.headline: Reuters shares fall after results.

text.p: Shares in Reuters Holdings Plc fell on Tuesday following the release of the company's 1996 results, reversing gains made ahead of the statement.
The shares were down a net 41p at 601 at 1126 GMT. The shares showed a gain of 12p just before the results.
Reuters reported a 17 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 701 million stg in the year and raised the total dividend by 20 percent to 11.75p.

Chief executive Peter Job said in the statement, however, that to gain critical mass Reuters had restructured its pricing to encourage conversions to its new 3000 range of products from the current 2000 series.
"This will make it difficult for the group to better the underlying revenue growth rate achieved in 1996," he said.
Job also said that "...robust sterling would severely restrict prospects for reported revenue and earnings growth".
The company, which last year suspended plans to return cash to shareholders via a share buyback scheme after a UK government tax ruling, said it continued to monitor developments in this area.
